GODSENT was a Swedish esports organization founded in April 2016 by Markus "pronax" Wallsten.

GODSENT ceased operations following the sale of its roster to Red Reserve and RFRSH's withdrawal from the team's operations in June 2018 before returning to activity in September 2019 after a merger with The Final Tribe. [1][2]

The organization once again ceased operations in September 2025, after being declared bankrupt by the Malmö District Court. [3]
